text:
Ibrahim: Heads-up, hitting an auth loop in WSL when running redwoodctl local serve from a symlinked home. CLI spawns browser, finishes auth, but profiles.json never updates and subsequent requests are 401.
Maya: Symlinked home? Like /home/ubuntu -> /mnt/c/Users/You?
Ibrahim: Exactly. Our dotfiles setup creates /home/dev -> /mnt/c/Users/dev. redwoodctl writes to ~/.redwood but the fs calls fail silently and we get a fallback to in-memory profile.
Rohit: Can you share the last lines from the debug log?
Ibrahim: paste:
```
2026-06-02T07:44:01Z fs: open /home/dev/.redwood/profiles.json: no such file or directory
2026-06-02T07:44:01Z auth: browser flow completed
2026-06-02T07:44:01Z fs: mkdir /home/dev/.redwood: permission denied
2026-06-02T07:44:01Z auth: persisted profile failed, using ephemeral session
2026-06-02T07:44:01Z runtime: request failed: 401 unauthorized
```
Maya: Permission denied on mkdir to a symlink target usually means Windows side ACLs or WSL mount options like metadata off.
Rohit: Two problems: (1) installer doesn't validate writability of ~/.redwood on first run, (2) auth flow falls back to ephemeral session without a clear warning. Users get 401 and no clue.
Ibrahim: Workaround was to point REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH somewhere writable: `export REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH=~/.redwood-wsl && mkdir -p ~/.redwood-wsl` then `redwoodctl auth login --reinit` which fixed it.
Maya: Proposal: add a preflight check in redwoodctl startup that validates the configured profile path is writable and prints an explicit error with suggested commands (mkdir, chown, or change mount options). Also change fallback to ephemeral to log a WARNING line with instructions instead of silent switch.
Rohit: Agreed. Also add a docs section for WSL and mounted/NTFS home gotchas and a short Docker/WSL snippet: `mount -t drvfs C:\Users /mnt/c -o metadata` to preserve POSIX perms.
doc-bot: Filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/issues/5602 "devex: detect unwritable REDWOOD config path on startup; warn instead of silent ephemeral fallback" (labels: devex, docs)
Ibrahim: I'll add a tiny PR to change the log level and error text, and include the WSL note in docs. Thanks!
